narrative: On the part. His roll for the afternoon, the long speech at the top, the cue words to the right. No new ink. The margin is the one he already wrote, and he does not touch it. On the part. He looks for a fresh mark and does not find one. The red thread is on another bundle. He goes toward the door with the roll as it is.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Played the old man and did not explain the sea.
